description: Request a callback from a business. They will contact the customer directly. No calendar booking is created.

agent_callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL that receives a webhook when the business responds.

customer.description: The customer the appointment or callback is for.

address.description: Where the work will be done. Ask the customer for it whenever the visit is at their home or business: some businesses' scheduling systems cannot book a job without it.

street.description: Street address, e.g. "605 E Main Street, Apt 2".

email.description: Customer's email address. Mode 1 sends the confirmation code here.

notes.description: What the customer needs, in their words.

customer_zip.description: Customer's ZIP code, if known. For a business with several locations, Canopy uses the location nearest to it unless location_id (or a slot or service tied to one location) decides. The result names the location used.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key when retrying so nothing is created twice. Derived automatically if omitted.

notes.description: Extra details for the business (added to the customer notes).

service_id.description: Service the customer is asking about, if known.

name: request_callback
title: Request a callback
